description: derm policy gate for Codex. Codex runs each line with its shell and lets a call through when a hook fails or times out, so derm's hook never crashes on purpose and caps its own waits below this timeout. /bin/sh by its absolute path runs hooks/derm-gate.sh, which runs `derm hook codex <event>` from derm's install folders, never from PATH (contracts/hook-dialects.md 9.1; rules case 227). On Windows Codex runs `commandWindows` with cmd.exe (Codex 0.167.2 codex-rs/hooks/src/engine/discovery.rs:654-662, command_runner.rs:448-470): there the plugin cannot reach derm, so PreToolUse blocks every call with exit 2 and a reason (pre_tool_use.rs:268) and names `derm connect codex --gate --write`, derm's Windows route (fix pass 7).

hooks.commandWindows: echo derm: on Windows the derm plugin's gate cannot start (it runs /bin/sh); turn the plugin off and run derm connect codex --gate --write, which registers derm.exe by its path 1>&2 & exit /B 2
